# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ships on Skia m151 with a broad managed-layer performance sprint and WebAssembly .NET 11 support. Key wins include allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding and Tag parsing, zero-copy Span reads for SKShaper, SKColor math ported to managed code, and Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11 WASM. A native resource leak in SKImage is also fixed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine is now built from the m151 milestone, and four rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes have been merged. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **WebAssembly build warning eliminated** — Removed a duplicate SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM define from the Skia submodule so Emscripten builds no longer report macro redefinition noise. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing overloads and performance** — SKColor.Parse now accepts ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and internal hex parsing was optimized, reducing allocations in text-heavy rendering loops. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **GRContextOptions unsafe modifier removed** — The unnecessary unsafe modifier was dropped from GRContextOptions. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native resource leak in the SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) overload is corrected, preventing memory growth in image-heavy workloads. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Performance: SKColor/SKColorF conversion ported to managed math** — The SKColor ↔ SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor single-value premultiply/unpremultiply are now computed in managed integer arithmetic, removing P/Invoke round-trips from common hot paths. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Performance: HarfBuzz allocation-free text encoding and tag parsing** — Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now encodes into a pooled buffer instead of allocating a new byte array, and both HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse eliminate their per-call char[4] allocations. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))
- **Performance: zero-copy spans for SKShaper glyph results** — Glyph result arrays from SKShaper are now read via Span<T>, removing managed array copies from shaping-heavy workloads. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly .NET 11 support with Emscripten 5.0.6** — Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries are included for the .NET 11 WASM target, with the new exnref exception-handling ABI. A preview-.NET WASM test job now guards against exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Adds allocation-free UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8 and eliminates the per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse, reducing GC pressure in shaping-heavy workloads. Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.
